dispositions.reason: The plan's line-reader sketch (Approach 1 and its prose) holds a literal U+FEFF in the BOM regex, which the repo's no-irregular-whitespace lint rule rejects and a reader cannot see; rewrite both places with the escape form so copying the sketch keeps AC-13's lint green.

The SPEC Constraint wants a permanent unit test for every AC in three named test files, while CONTRIBUTING drops tests that match English in docs or the changelog and bars ac-* files at merge, so AC-11 to AC-13 cannot have a permanent test at that level; the plan cannot settle this and the SPEC must narrow the Constraint (or a human must accept the deviation).

The plan says the ac-* files must not reach CI but names no step or owner that folds or drops the six .github/scripts/ac-phargus-input-*.test.mjs files before the branch is pushed; add that step, with its owner, so root CI does not run tests that need src/phargus node_modules.

The plan's zero-event cleanup in the finally block does not say what happens when a close or unlink rejects, which would replace the captured failure and lose the cause the SPEC wants named; state that cleanup uses force removal or never replaces the original failure.
